scope: Product-only release candidate. Existing music preserved in a separately saved copy and reopened after testing. Music changes and approvals were confined to a disposable QA Live Set and isolated account. Installed production Bridge and production deployment unchanged.

live_qa.automation_regression: Live returned to the old value after the final point. Fixed and retested: beat 15.99 reads -17.984 dB for a -18 dB request.
live_qa.effect_readback: Saturator Drive +1.0 dB and Dry/Wet 5 percent
live_qa.arrangement: 8 bars at 124 BPM; Kick and Bass begin at bar 1. Kick audition requested at zero-based beat 8, recorded 4.24 seconds with signal, stopped and restored temporary state.
interruptions: Initial planning request was interrupted by the test harness closing its browser; no musical actions ran and the UI reported interruption.
Isolated QA reached its 5 USD AI allowance. Increased only QA to 12 USD, signed in again, inspected before continuing. Production limits unchanged.
live_qa.data_policy: No QA recordings, chats, credentials, approvals, music or marketing scripts included in the product commit.

remaining_release_gates: First-time setup on a clean supported Mac: Gatekeeper launch, fresh privacy permissions, core AbletonOSC installation and extension registration. The integration updater updates an existing registration; it is not a complete first-install wizard.
Production checkout/webhook and password-reset email delivery smoke tests; automated billing and auth regressions passed but no real charge or email was initiated in this audit.
Coordinated installer, backend and frontend publication followed by production smoke verification. PR 26 remains the release candidate.
limitations: Unit fixtures do not establish that all features work in a real Ableton session
Generated-tone stem health verifies packaging and alignment, not musical separation quality

Actual music tests used source Bridge with the same candidate integration, plus the signed capture helper. Packaged GUI/runtime and updater were tested separately, not a complete newly installed end-to-end session.
Updater download transport used the local final DMG; published HTTPS download for the new version is not yet available
Full-song reference interpretation and separation quality are not guaranteed by generated-tone packaging checks or browser fixtures
Intel, Windows and other macOS versions were not tested
No new production installer or application deployment was performed
